review.outcome: Grounded context can help, but manual aliases and false matches block generalization claims. Removing supplied files regressed.

review.outcome: No safe improvement, or gains coupled to negative/rank regressions.

review.outcome: Safe mechanism gains after preserving distinct facts, original text and packet limits.

review.outcome: Availability fixes recover missing representations without changing semantic thresholds.

review.outcome: Safe bounded gains while literal/file contracts and full pools remain protected.

review.family: hidden explicit conclusions and diagnostic/conclusion combination
review.outcome: Safe gains on constructed long-note views. Arbitrary single-paragraph suffixes failed an existing contract and remain rejected.

hypothesis: MiniLM can represent terse topic fragments differently from grammatical requests. Supplement with one deterministic question/request view, using the unchanged normal threshold and preserving all incumbent ranks. No aliases or document rewrites.
eligibility: At most three whitespace words, nonempty distinctive FTS terms, no failure or supplied files, no exact incumbent task title, declared positive encoder limit and reformulated text fully inside that limit. Only unused result slots may be filled. Native-capable providers only; no relaxation of strict search.
selection: Fixed variants on original/fresh development first. Reject each variant for any individual answer/fact rank or delivery loss, negative IDs/order change, scope or budget violation. Replay all historical development views and crate contracts before reserved scoring. A safe development gain may ship with unchanged exposed reserved recall; do not retune on reserved outcomes.
stopping: If no view passes development, restore baseline and record failures before trying a different mechanism.
limitations: All fixtures and reserved incidents are already exposed. No new independent cases, blind semantic result or live-agent success claim.
decision: All three fixed query views reproduce original/fresh development recall with no gains; removed. No reserved trial was scored.
